name: FrustrumFogMode
meaning: Frustrum field +0x34, the curve selector of Frustrum_BuildFogRamp 0x419e86. Decoded from the assembly at 0x419eb0-0x419ec6 (the Ghidra output mislabels these branches).

name: FOG_LINEAR
meaning: factor = 255 * (1 - (i+1)/256.0); this is the value set by Frustrum_Construct

name: FOG_NONE
meaning: any other value fills the whole ramp with 0xFF000000, i.e. no fog at any depth
